Hyundai Staria

2021–2024 · 2.2 diesel · automatic · Minivan

  • 8–9 seats, 5 suitcases
  • High roof

Nine seats and the newest bodywork in our fleet — the Staria is what we hand over when a group arrives with more people than an ordinary minivan takes. The high roof is not a styling line: an adult can move down the cabin without stooping, and the glass area is large enough that passengers in the last row see the Caucasus ridge rather than the headrest in front of them.

Mechanically it is a 2.2 diesel with all-wheel drive and an automatic gearbox, using about 8.8 l/100 km — economical for a nine-seater. Clearance of 186 mm takes the rough asphalt of Racha and Kazbegi in its stride.

Five suitcases fit with every row in use, and that number decides most bookings: tour groups, school trips, airport transfers for large families. The rate is 260 ₾ a day, the deposit 1,000 ₾ and the minimum driver age 23. All-wheel drive is not the same thing as off-road clearance, though — Ushguli and Omalo remain open only to the 4x4 category, which you can compare on Fleet.
